definitions.explanation: Repeated action to improve a skill or ability.

examples.japanese: ピアノの{練習|れんしゅう}をする。
{毎日|まいにち}{練習|れんしゅう}すれば{上手|じょうず}になる。
examples.english: If you practice every day, you'll get better.

examples.japanese: {練習|れんしゅう}{試合|じあい}をする。

notes:
{練習|れんしゅう} is composed of {練|れん} (train) + {習|しゅう} (learn).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {練習|れんしゅう}する: to practice
- {練習|れんしゅう}{問題|もんだい}: practice problems
- {練習|れんしゅう}{試合|じあい}: practice match/game
- {練習|れんしゅう}{中|ちゅう}: during practice

VS. {稽古|けいこ}:
- {練習|れんしゅう}: general practice (modern, any skill)
- {稽古|けいこ}: practice (traditional arts, martial arts)
